5. During the STEAL, the opposing team will get a chance to guess ONE survey answer. If they answer right, they get to steal ALL the scores the other team earned in that round. If not, the playing team retains the scores.
6. The team who gets the most points in the end wins the game. The standard number of rounds is two (2) rounds.
